protocol.question: Spatial convergence of fixed-state mirrored arrangement and physical velocity reversal responses.
protocol.state: For each seed reuse the verified grid56 dt.005 full t=.3 Fourier checkpoint and central positions. Prolong its band-limited field with exact Fourier mode copying and FFT normalization; same present continuum polynomial, marker locations and neighborhood offsets at every grid. A new grid56 dt.0025 continuation provides the same-state reference and separates time change from historical grid comparisons. Do not replay initial conditions or refine the original long matrix.
protocol.scope: 16 main pairs +2 half-step pairs; if frozen screens fail, four grid224 main pairs and one grid224 half-step pair. Maximum23 pairs46forward field branches. No automatic expansion beyond224 or duration .2.
protocol.dynamics: Unchanged parent Navier-Stokes solver, joint Heun integration and trilinear velocity/exact-Jacobian sampler, zero force and mean, fixed viscosity. Normal/reversed fluid motion; original/global-mirrored cloud and anchored reflected neighbor probes. Markers passive.
protocol.coarse_reuse: Previous mirror-direction grid56 .005 data are compared for time sensitivity at fixed branch state and matched positions; previous grid38 and grid56 comparisons are descriptive, not the common-state convergence ladder.
protocol.targets: Pointwise forward FTLE for original and globally mirrored clouds; anchored finite-cloud log singular-value rate and mean neighbor-center log-distance rate, each at both motion signs. Primary .2. All saved horizons reported; no threshold for finite-cloud/pair targets.
protocol.screen_scope: Every seed and all four cells for the three primary target families. RMS differences across consecutive main grids must contract for each target/cell. Finest pointwise event Jaccard must pass at fixed training-only threshold. Temporal screen is on the prechosen control seed at the finest grid across all targets/cells; previous fine half-step control is also reported. Effect drift compares primary global direction RMS differences and anchored arrangement/direction/interaction RMS contrasts in both finite target families, each independent seed. Operational empirical stability screens for this finite interval, not proof of continuum solution or formal order of accuracy.
protocol.extension_rule: Run stage56/80/112/160 with halfstep112/160, analyze against frozen screens. Extend to224 plus its halfstep only if any screen fails. Stop there and report any remaining failures; do not loosen tolerances, select seeds or tune thresholds after results.
protocol.provenance: Check original full checkpoint/raw archive hashes, executed-source hashes and current GitHub source blobs before runs. Exact source bytes required for completed new cache reuse; old source analysis allows only LF/CRLF equivalence. Preserve partial/failure checkpoints. Exclusive PID lock; never duplicate live jobs.
protocol.numerical_checks: Finite arrays, CFL<.5, spectral divergence<1e-10, relative energy residual<.005; energy and Fourier roundtrip invariance under prolongation. Record probe volume error/high-band energy, final shared-band Eulerian spectra, checkpoints each saved interval.
protocol.limits: Four reused initial conditions, not new independent tests; two-sign branches and grids dependent. Fixed checkpoint convergence resolves spatial evolution/interpolation from the supplied t=.3 band-limited state, not continuum accuracy of its earlier preparation or history-predictor forecasts. Starting-location accumulated stretch is not exact Eulerian peak onset/location. Original nonsmooth periodic strain and noncentral maxima remain separate limitations. No material memory, marker force or asymptotic Lyapunov claim.
